fb72f60f5e757426cc1aae22138f5a445123816c.source: Unlocks net settlement of verified reciprocal obligations between participating institutions. Clearing must preserve every holder's entitlement and settle the funded net balance without creating money. Native interbank settlement remains unavailable.

d25fda94e0b12de32addc1dd9950d7ee45a67ad6.source: gold into a bank. New ownership units are priced at current net asset value. Subscription proceeds increase paid-in capital rather than realized profit and buy a proportional claim on subsequent distributions.

e59bf0abf771c51cdacdf10ee31acf50bf18e655.text: 允许银行股份转让服务在确定的持有人之间转移现有的注册单位。转让会改变所有权，但不会发行新单位或创造银行利润。登记机构必须有能力并保护每个持有人的权利。

a95e14106a6c79f055f65cf669b1c836cf77d815.source: Unlocks recorded collateral pledges and their eligibility checks. Encumbered assets cannot secure a second claim, and recovery must preserve the original debt relationship. Native collateral execution remains unavailable.
a95e14106a6c79f055f65cf669b1c836cf77d815.text: 解锁记录的抵押品承诺及其资格检查。担保资产不能获得第二次债权，追回必须保留原有的债务关系。本地抵押品执行仍然不可用。

9d759e13f30ed1ff24489c0c464c888484d54759.source: Unlocks the Overseas Investment voyage-partnership mandate. Each venture requires an identified partner, funded capital, a recorded profit-sharing agreement and settlement of realized proceeds. Project execution remains unavailable in this development build.
9d759e13f30ed1ff24489c0c464c888484d54759.text: 解锁海外投资航程合作授权。每个企业都需要一个确定的合作伙伴、融资资本、记录的利润分享协议以及已实现收益的结算。在此开发版本中项目执行仍然不可用。

8a3a6518affc9ac1e81794718ccc29ad65aa4ae8.text: 允许全额支付账单。购买者支付

c72ad65eae7a225f2ecff02c27f271842b444106.source: gold before issuance; the bank records an equal payable and cash commitment. The named holder may redeem the bill after one month, once only. Issuance is not profit.
c72ad65eae7a225f2ecff02c27f271842b444106.text: 发行前的黄金；银行记录了等额应付和现金承诺。指定持有人可在一个月后赎回票据，仅限一次。发行不是利润。

abf7523877f29037211c656aabda0eae5698b896.source: Unlocks Merchant Finance forward-delivery contracts. Each agreement must record its counterparty, goods, quantity, delivery date and backing without reusing encumbered inventory. Native trading execution remains unavailable.
abf7523877f29037211c656aabda0eae5698b896.text: 解锁商业金融远期交割合同。每份协议必须记录其交易对手、货物、数量、交货日期和支持，不得重复使用抵押库存。本地交易执行仍然不可用。

2af50549e475beee2277879eba38f1ada24935c4.source: Unlocks the Merchant Finance inventory mandate. Commodity positions must represent funded native goods holdings and preserve acquisition cost, quantity and custody. Trading execution remains unavailable in this development build.
2af50549e475beee2277879eba38f1ada24935c4.text: 解锁商业金融库存授权。商品头寸必须代表受资助的本土商品持有量，并保留收购成本、数量和保管权。在此开发版本中，交易执行仍然不可用。

5b906428fcb8e2b60e728eebc218c9d63230210c.source: Unlocks the Overseas Investment company-equity mandate. Financial shares are recorded separately from political subject control. Only verified company distributions may become bank income; subscriptions and return of capital are excluded. Native execution remains unavailable.
5b906428fcb8e2b60e728eebc218c9d63230210c.text: 解锁海外投资公司股权授权。金融股与政治主体控制分开记录。只有经过验证的公司分配才可能成为银行收入；认购和资本返还不包括在内。本机执行仍然不可用。

c9b72d92ebdf45fc980f2d2203a0c6f1e10c8874.source: Unlocks the Merchant Finance corporate credit mandate. Loans must transfer bank cash to an identified enterprise and create an equal recoverable claim; principal repayments do not enter profits. Native execution remains unavailable.
c9b72d92ebdf45fc980f2d2203a0c6f1e10c8874.text: 解锁商业金融企业信贷授权。贷款必须将银行现金转移给指定的企业并产生同等的可收回债权；本金偿还不计入利润。本机执行仍然不可用。

59da677c7a14568fb80eec979c6a33ad311b988c.source: Unlocks the sovereign restructuring mandate. Revised maturity, interest and principal must attach to the existing claim, with the debtor's agreement. Execution remains unavailable until native debt reconciliation is supported.
59da677c7a14568fb80eec979c6a33ad311b988c.text: 解锁主权重组授权。经债务人同意，修改后的到期日、利息和本金必须附加到现有债权上。在支持本地债务调节之前，执行仍然不可用。

b0e8d903cafca5ae01796cac4143902ce7f9a604.source: Unlocks secured temporary liquidity. Funding must come from a real counterparty, remain within cash and capital limits and carry recorded collateral. Queued withdrawals retain priority. Native facility execution remains unavailable.
b0e8d903cafca5ae01796cac4143902ce7f9a604.text: 释放有保障的临时流动性。资金必须来自真正的交易对手，保持在现金和资本限额内，并携带记录的抵押品。排队提款保留优先权。本机设施执行仍然不可用。

6c1896f6662a73128eb1dfea2186d23b3ebcf435.source: Unlocks margin requirements for Merchant Finance forward positions. Exposure must be measured against available collateral and cash, with additional funding required before commitments increase. Native trading and margin execution remain unavailable.
6c1896f6662a73128eb1dfea2186d23b3ebcf435.text: 解锁商业金融远期头寸的保证金要求。风险敞口必须根据可用的抵押品和现金来衡量，并在承诺增加之前需要额外的资金。本地交易和保证金执行仍然不可用。

2718cab7e91baf1de4fae498b369990ef0f7adc1.source: Unlocks security for Overseas Investment projects. Identified project assets and proceeds must be pledged to a single recorded obligation, with priority preserved through settlement or recovery. Native project execution remains unavailable.
2718cab7e91baf1de4fae498b369990ef0f7adc1.text: 解锁海外投资项目的安全性。已确定的项目资产和收益必须抵押给单一记录的债务，并通过结算或追偿保留优先权。本机项目执行仍然不可用。

075af5aecf599c1e0dea125a9e17b3a0c6a5a32f.source: Unlocks the public backstop mandate for an authorized chartered bank. Assistance requires a real treasury contribution and recorded claims or ownership units; guarantees cannot mint cash or erase losses. Standing backstop execution is not yet implemented.
075af5aecf599c1e0dea125a9e17b3a0c6a5a32f.text: 解锁授权特许银行的公共支持授权。援助需要真实的国库捐款和记录的索赔或所有权单位；担保不能创造现金或消除损失。站立逆止执行尚未实施。

3362980d09fedb6ef7a0cc1aebbfc8f3a330d8e0.source: Unlocks sovereign note issuance for an authorized chartered bank. Notes are redeemable liabilities; backing excludes cash raised by selling the notes themselves. Native issuance and holder-payment routing remain unavailable.
3362980d09fedb6ef7a0cc1aebbfc8f3a330d8e0.text: 为授权特许银行解锁主权票据发行。票据是可赎回负债；支持不包括通过出售票据本身筹集的现金。本地发行和持有人支付路由仍然不可用。

4aac7b76b6406bc8198d8e3bdd154a4122b56b85.source: gold with a twelve-month maturity. Interest accrues monthly at the rate accepted when the account opens; immature principal cannot be withdrawn. Deposits remain liabilities of the bank.
4aac7b76b6406bc8198d8e3bdd154a4122b56b85.text: 期限为十二个月的黄金。利息按开户时接受的利率每月累积；未到期本金不能提取。存款仍然是银行的负债。

4e936b50206a98cdba0218e86edce58629d9270d.source: Unlocks Merchant Finance receipts backed by identified inventory lots. Each receipt reserves ten unencumbered units and charges a funded custody fee. Native goods custody must be supported before new receipts can be issued.
4e936b50206a98cdba0218e86edce58629d9270d.text: 解锁由已识别库存批次支持的商业财务收据。每张收据保留十个未支配单位，并收取一定的托管费。在开具新收据之前，必须支持本地货物保管。

e25019e6eb2bdb448925cd449941d678e9fc9fcf.source: The charter relationship has no automatic tribute. State income comes from deposit interest and dividends on owned bank shares.
e25019e6eb2bdb448925cd449941d678e9fc9fcf.text: 包机关系没有自动贡品。国家收入来自银行股票的存款利息和股息。

95f513755486a9e2d69aaf7b023ec69e0e243dba.source: sailors while an exploration mandate is authorized. Sailors must come from the company or a funded transfer from its political controller.
95f513755486a9e2d69aaf7b023ec69e0e243dba.text: 授权勘探任务时的水手。水手必须来自公司或来自其政治控制者的资金转移。

682abc71434f9afaa3e662fc58075d9bd1f37389.source: Voluntarily accept or stop accepting fully funded bills and notes offered at par through mod interactions. A transfer still requires your available treasury. Accepted claims remain redeemable after acceptance is closed. Native payments continue to use gold.
682abc71434f9afaa3e662fc58075d9bd1f37389.text: 自愿接受或停止接受通过 mod 交互按面值提供的全额资助的票据和票据。转账仍然需要您可用的资金。接受结束后，已接受的索赔仍然可以赎回。本地支付继续使用黄金。

ba5a37f01662085cb4885dbae3dfdfba47b0556a.source: Native treasury is cash. Deposits and notes are liabilities. Lending exchanges cash for an asset; principal, subscriptions and issuance are not profit.
ba5a37f01662085cb4885dbae3dfdfba47b0556a.text: 本国国库是现金。存款和票据都是负债。贷款以现金换取资产；本金、认购和发行均不产生利润。

5c79885d3898f9a833df2fc360f2874327d75e14.source: Native coupon observations classify the native net budget; they never move gold twice. Settled native payoff proceeds release actual acquisition cost before recognizing a gain or loss. Company distributions and custom funded receipts enter their own buckets. Principal, deposits and subscriptions are excluded from profits.
5c79885d3898f9a833df2fc360f2874327d75e14.text: 原生息票观察对原生净预算进行分类；他们从来不会两次转移黄金。已结算的本机支付收益在确认损益之前释放实际购置成本。公司分配和定制资助的收据进入各自的桶。本金、存款和认购不计入利润。

b753f36323c5ea5f74fb84277219faea4bba6405.source: Review separately held cash and obligations of a destroyed institution. Trustee authority never makes its cash part of the national treasury.
b753f36323c5ea5f74fb84277219faea4bba6405.text: 审查被摧毁机构单独持有的现金和债务。受托机构从未将其现金纳入国库。

6514aff452cbf823758f935979ee502c1f10cc75.source: Banking houses that owe one another many payments need not settle every obligation separately in coin. Clearing accounts reconcile their claims and transfer only the remaining balance, reducing the money required to sustain commerce.
6514aff452cbf823758f935979ee502c1f10cc75.text: 相互欠债多笔的银行无需用硬币单独偿还每一项债务。清算账户可以核对其债权并仅转移剩余余额，从而减少维持商业所需的资金。

008686a836204bed1c4a5cc7af74ef987f865c6c.source: Research unlocks the mandate. The bank must also meet its specialization, liquidity and operating requirements. Unavailable execution remains disabled.
008686a836204bed1c4a5cc7af74ef987f865c6c.text: 研究解锁了任务。银行还必须满足其专业化、流动性和运营要求。不可用的执行保持禁用状态。

7eec3fcd13729be92b9aad6f4e187035283b46d2.text: 银行拥有的现金和记录资产。

65963ae23e4c39ea2236d48131990565f75881b1.source: Loans, equity positions, inventory and projects are recorded asset values, not cash available to spend. Principal repayments exchange a loan asset for cash; they do not create profit.
65963ae23e4c39ea2236d48131990565f75881b1.text: 贷款、股权、库存和项目均记录为资产价值，而不是可用于支出的现金。本金偿还将贷款资产兑换成现金；他们不创造利润。

bb8d9b540e68cca4f1d06ee3f91b1b8a80d8b284.source: Authorize your chartered bank, or an independent bank with a branch in your capital, to exchange specie for fully backed redeemable notes after the required research. A completed Central Bank in your capital is also required for new issues. Authorization creates no gold and can be withdrawn.
bb8d9b540e68cca4f1d06ee3f91b1b8a80d8b284.text: 在进行必要的研究后，授权您的特许银行或在您首都设有分行的独立银行将硬币兑换为完全支持的可赎回票据。新的发行还需要在您的首都建立一个完整的中央银行。授权不会创造黄金并且可以撤回。

ea4592450efa20772b814249a948c335ed75cf3d.source: Funded payment received at the last monthly settlement. These transfers are already in your treasury and must not be added again to the native income total.
ea4592450efa20772b814249a948c335ed75cf3d.text: 最后每月结算时收到的资助付款。这些转移已经存在于您的国库中，不得再次添加到本地收入总额中。

11d0c05ebbfc90d6ae740e022f21de81c74eb799.source: A banking house need not rely entirely on the fortune of its founding family. Subscriptions bring additional partners into the enterprise, pooling their capital while recording each investor's claim upon its future prosperity.
11d0c05ebbfc90d6ae740e022f21de81c74eb799.text: 银行不必完全依赖其创始家族的财富。认购将更多的合作伙伴带入企业，汇集他们的资本，同时记录每个投资者对其未来繁荣的主张。

ddb58616635f8778c0e2820eb9fa569e968ccf51.source: of an Overseas-permitted company. This is primary financing, not a purchase from an existing shareholder.
ddb58616635f8778c0e2820eb9fa569e968ccf51.text: 海外许可公司的。这是主要融资，而不是从现有股东处购买。

8bdfa9123579319c7a8167ce011cf445cd8fdb91.source: holds its own treasury, assets and obligations. These totals belong to the bank, separately from your state treasury. Merchant Finance specializes in trade and corporate lending; Overseas Investment specializes in ventures and companies. A bank chooses one permanent specialization.
8bdfa9123579319c7a8167ce011cf445cd8fdb91.text: 拥有自己的金库、资产和债务。这些总额属于银行，与国库分开。 Merchant Finance 专门从事贸易和企业贷款；海外投资专注于企业和公司。银行选择一个永久的专业化。

fce1ca00753fa34a7ff5646232c9c1808c8886fb.source: A partner's fortune need not remain tied to the same banking house forever. Recognized transfers of ownership let investors sell their interests to others while the institution continues its business without withdrawing its capital.
fce1ca00753fa34a7ff5646232c9c1808c8886fb.text: 合伙人的财富不必永远与同一家银行挂钩。经认可的所有权转让允许投资者将其权益出售给其他人，而机构则可以在不撤回资本的情况下继续开展业务。

1b378ddf94b6ade63b8b0c686344f8e066d9d258.source: Transfer recorded bank ownership units between funded parties. Requires Bank Share Dealing research and the Reformation age or later. This row reports permission; it does not itself execute a secondary share trade.
1b378ddf94b6ade63b8b0c686344f8e066d9d258.text: 在受资助方之间转移记录的银行所有权单位。需要银行股票交易研究和宗教改革时代或更晚的时间。该行报告权限；它本身并不执行二级股票交易。

417fa81c9cdb629a6f26ae83758ff889a6af75e5.source: Operating: new business is permitted when its other requirements are met. Cash under pressure: available cash is exhausted. Withdrawals queued: unpaid withdrawal requests suspend new business. Insolvent: liabilities exceed assets. In resolution or Closed: ordinary business is restricted. Existing claims remain recorded.
417fa81c9cdb629a6f26ae83758ff889a6af75e5.text: 经营：在满足其他要求的情况下允许开展新业务。现金压力：可用现金已耗尽。提款排队：未支付的提款请求将暂停新业务。资不抵债：负债超过资产。决议中或已关闭：普通业务受到限制。现有索赔仍被记录。

cc9b78289c6bc79bcc8f6e965a567dcb58051e00.source: Reserved presentation preference for the detailed statement view.
cc9b78289c6bc79bcc8f6e965a567dcb58051e00.text: 为详细报表视图保留呈现偏好。

3ba5cee2fecc9b0a673555448d977582d2f7fc68.source: Notification presentation preference; obligations are never canceled by muting.
3ba5cee2fecc9b0a673555448d977582d2f7fc68.text: 通知呈现偏好；义务永远不会因静音而取消。

6364c536386cc0570b32876c097c77eafebfc8ab.source: Use static transaction receipts and warnings. Disable to allow brief, single transaction highlights after committed payments; no looping financial flashes.
6364c536386cc0570b32876c097c77eafebfc8ab.text: 使用静态交易收据和警告。禁止在承诺付款后允许简短的单笔交易亮点；没有循环的财务闪光。

cb035300b272c6c49cb66cf653f10b9512fb099e.text: 仅演示设置。制度政策是在经济中管理的。

179530d606a08c888517fb0a2e5d256054e8d954.source: A harvest, shipment or workshop order may be sold before its delivery. Agreements that fix a future price help merchants arrange their affairs despite the uncertainty of distant markets and changing seasons.

d9e9ccffb7509c39d7e3d654bfa36fe61bbbda2e.text: 为贸易提供融资的银行家也可以自己持有货物。谷物、羊毛和其他商品成为投资，其价值取决于储存、运输和遥远市场不断变化的需求。

abe72f8081deaac5b814b4fcb3cfa97beaf35721.source: Large trading enterprises require fortunes that few merchants can supply alone. Dividing ownership among investors allows a company to assemble lasting capital while distributing the risks and rewards of its undertakings.

4c002fe1c86b02b1196de2876d226f690b0b5149.source: Subscribe capital for an ownership share in a recognized company. Requires Company Equity research, Overseas Investment and the Reformation age or later. Native company issuance and holder settlement are unavailable in this build.
